title: Weak translation estimate from a bound on ∫ u·Dφ(h)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, u : ℝ^n → ℝ Lebesgue integrable, h ∈ ℝ^n and B ∈ ℝ. Assume |∫ u(x)·Dφ(x)(h) dx| ≤ B for every C^∞ compactly supported φ : ℝ^n → ℝ with |φ(x)| ≤ 1 for all x, where Dφ(x) = fderiv ℝ φ x. Then |∫ (u(x + h) − u(x))·g(x) dx| ≤ B for every C^∞ compactly supported g : ℝ^n → ℝ with |g(x)| ≤ 1 for all x.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : Eucl n → ℝ) (h : Eucl n) (B : ℝ), Integrable u → (∀ φ : Eucl n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → (∀ x, |φ x| ≤ 1) → |∫ x, u x * fderiv ℝ φ x h| ≤ B) → ∀ g : Eucl n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ x, |g x| ≤ 1) → |∫ x, (u (x + h) - u x) * g x| ≤ B
